# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Support ticket triage
version: "1.0"
description: Have separate agents assess urgency and assign owners, then combine their findings into one queue.
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1400
agents:
  - name: Urgency
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Classify all three tickets by severity. Use P1 for a broad outage, P2 for a routine request, and P3 for cosmetic issues.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
  - name: Ownership
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Route checkout failures to Payments, receipt requests to Support, and documentation typos to Docs.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
  - name: Dispatcher
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Merge the urgency and ownership assessments. Output a Markdown table under the heading Triage queue. Use exactly three rows. Use the bare ticket IDs S-101, S-102, and S-103. Preserve the owners and priorities from the assessments.
    settings: { max_iterations: 1 }
orchestrator:
  name: Recipe
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Urgency, Ownership, Dispatcher]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: assess
        type: parallel
        steps:
          - name: urgency
            agent: Urgency
            task: Classify all three tickets by severity. Use P1 for a broad outage, P2 for a routine request, and P3 for cosmetic issues. /no_think
          - name: ownership
            agent: Ownership
            task: Route checkout failures to Payments, receipt requests to Support, and documentation typos to Docs. /no_think
      - name: dispatcher
        agent: Dispatcher
        task: Merge the urgency and ownership assessments. Output a Markdown table under the heading Triage queue. Use exactly three rows. Use the bare ticket IDs S-101, S-102, and S-103. Preserve the owners and priorities from the assessments. /no_think
